text: Need a straight answer please. My stepson is 3. He will not settle tonight. Bath, story, the lot, same routine as every night, and he's been up and down out of bed since half seven, wandering into the lounge, asking for water, asking for his mum, back up again. It's now gone ten. Other than that he's completely fine. He's eaten normally, he's been playing, no sign of anything wrong with him at all, he's just wide awake and wound up. His mum's away for work till Thursday and I'm wondering if that's all it is. What I want to know is: is there anything I should actually be worried about here, or do I just keep putting him back to bed until he gives up? I don't want to be told to go to A&E for a kid who just won't sleep, but I also don't want to miss something if there's a reason a 3 year old suddenly does this.
